## Summary

What changed and why?

## Related Issue

Link the human-approved GitHub Issue.

## Changes

- Concisely describe the implementation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Map each item to the approved Issue. A checked box records verification; it is not evidence by itself.

- [ ] Criterion and supporting evidence

## Validation

List the tests and checks executed and their observed results.

## Independent QA

Summarize Max's review, revalidation after corrections, and any outstanding findings. Do not represent this as a native GitHub approval.

## Risks and Limitations

Disclose known issues, assumptions, trade-offs, and anything not verified.

## Readiness Checklist

- [ ] All acceptance criteria have been verified with evidence.
- [ ] Max has completed independent QA.
- [ ] All blocking QA findings are resolved.
- [ ] All required CI checks are passing.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and risks are disclosed.
- [ ] Changes made after QA were appropriately revalidated.
- [ ] Alex has checked readiness without treating it as human approval.
